However, the result we proved in Corollary 32 is not enough. We conjecture that the parameters in that result can be improved, as follows ▶ Conjecture 33. For any constant C ≥ 1, there exist positive constants γ, δ ∈ (0, 1] with γ ≥ C · δ such that the following holds. There exists a deterministic quasipolynomial-time algorithm that, on input x ∈ {0, 1}∗ , outputs a communication matrix M ∈ {0, 1}N ×N and a number k ∈ N, with k ≤ N = |x|O(1) , such that 1. if x is a YES instance of SAT, then LB B 3 (M ) ≤ O(k) and C3 (M ) ≤ log k + O(1), and γ 2. if x is a NO instance of SAT, then L3,N −δ (M ) ≥ Ω(N · k) and CB B 3,N −δ (M ) ≥ log k + γ · log N − O(1). 4
